title: A short source check of selected reading proposals
instructions: Output-informed diagnostic review. The source of each proposal is not identified. Compare each available proposed text with its original scan and unchanged OCR. There are two actual selected outputs: Sample A has a complete proposed reading; Sample B is rejected by automated validation because one of eight proposals makes no text change, so it has no complete proposed reading. Sample B’s eight old/new proposals are shown exactly as returned and none is salvaged or applied. The third fixed selection has no produced output and is shown as unavailable; no substitute is used. Please judge only whether the shown text agrees with the print, and note uncertainty where needed. The packet shows at most two actual output cards plus the unavailable status and has a hard combined review limit of 10 minutes. No additional review round, full run, corpus change, or broader policy decision is requested. Stop after 10 minutes or sooner; for any unfinished sample, select Not reviewed — time limit reached. No judgment is inferred for an unfinished sample.
